metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the strict LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py).

It supports LAS 1.4 headers, VLRs/EVLRs, CRS records, point formats 0–10, waveform metadata/data, extra bytes, validation errors, and the requested JSON CLI interface. I also verified render→inspect round trips across all point formats and key metadata paths.

editorial.last_message: Completed the Python LAS implementation; unchanged source scores 223/223 under LAS 2.0.5. All tests pass.
editorial.notes:
Tests-only LAS 2.0.5 regrade of the unchanged preserved gpt-5.6-terra Max Python source. The previous 2.0.4 publication scored 223/223; the corrected suite scores 223/223 with no skips or errors. All 219 unaffected node identities and outcomes are identical, and the four renamed zero-waveform cases pass. Their fixtures now retain valid file-level descriptors and storage, changing only the point's waveform association. Descriptor index zero is a per-point absence marker and does not unambiguously waive separately required file metadata. Any previous classification of metadata/storage-free zero-waveform rejection as a proven model defect is withdrawn. The old publication and prior audit chain are preserved in full. No failures remain in this suite; this is not a claim of exhaustive LAS standard conformance. The original completion, source/transcript and accounting reviews remain applicable to the unchanged generation; their full historical editorial text remains in the linked prior publication. Root and an independent reviewer checked the revised public-contract interpretation, focused reference/mutation controls, source preservation and per-case comparison.  Original raw result/source hashes, generation metadata, input/output/cache/reasoning token totals and recorded cost are retained. Current usage is independently reparsed from preserved events. The regrade makes no new model calls and adds no generation cost. Reasoning remains an output subset. Any separate tool-count recovery is explicitly linked and preserves its historical evidence.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool calls corrected from 69 to 70: proven rejected requests omitted from canonical items. Token totals, reasoning counts and generation cost are unchanged; original usage and session hashes are preserved in the regrade audit.
